deadline_text_verbatim: 31.05.2026 Ende der Bewerbungsphase (Ausschlussfrist) für Alt-Abiturient*innen für Humanmedizin, Tiermedizin, Zahnmedizin und Pharmazie mit einem HZB-Zeugnis vor 16.01.2026
source_authority_note: hochschulstart.de fails looksOfficial() (no .edu/.ac./.gov suffix). Official application system - per coordination DECISION 1 (2026-08-21, documented in source-authority-gap.md), an application system is HIGH authority for facts it owns (platform-wide deadlines/eligibility it sets for the nationally-restricted subjects it administers), not authoritative for a specific university's own programme-level facts even when displayed on the platform. Here it IS the correct authority: LMU's own pages (see REQ-2026-08-21-LMU0015 and the 'Where do I apply' page) confirm Medicine/Dentistry/Veterinary Medicine/Pharmacy admissions at LMU are routed through hochschulstart.de/SfH's national procedure, not set by LMU directly.
limitations: Deadline already passed as of the retrieval date (2026-08-21). Applies only to applicants whose HZB (school-leaving/university-entrance qualification) was obtained BEFORE 16.01.2026 ('Alt-Abiturient*innen'/previous-cycle graduates) - a different, later deadline (see DL-2026-08-21-LMU0011) applies to applicants with a more recent qualification. Bimodal deadline depending on qualification date, not a single uniform date for all applicants - do not treat as a simple scalar deadline. cycle_year=2026 per the resolved convention (entry/teaching-start calendar year for 'Wintersemester 2026/27' is 2026).
researcher_notes: National Zentrales Verfahren (ZV) deadline for Humanmedizin, Tiermedizin, Zahnmedizin and Pharmazie, administered centrally by hochschulstart.de / SfH (Stiftung für Hochschulzulassung), not by LMU directly. LMU offers all four of these nationally-restricted subjects (Medicine, Dentistry, Pharmacy, and Veterinary Medicine via LMU's Tierärztliche Fakultät). LMU's own 'Where do I apply' and 'Prerequisites' pages both confirm applicants to these subjects must use the SfH national allocation procedure rather than applying to LMU directly for the first stage. As of retrieval (2026-08-21) the WS2026/27 hochschulstart cycle's coordination/matching phase was still actively in progress per the same page (dates through late August 2026), even though the application-submission deadlines themselves had already closed.
